description: This file contains Python code for testing and demonstrating scripting with PyTorch's JIT compiler. It defines a utility function to script and save a module, and a class 'Test' with multiple scripted methods for different data types and tensor operations.

classes.name: Test
classes.description: A scripted module with various methods to test different data types, tensor manipulations, and control flow, intended for testing TorchScript functionalities.

methods.name: scriptAndSave(module, fileName)
methods.description: Scripts a given PyTorch module and saves it to a file in the specified output directory.

methods.name: forward(self, input)
methods.description: A placeholder method returning None, for testing scripting of forward pass.

methods.name: bool eqBool(self, input: bool)
methods.description: Returns the boolean input, testing boolean scripting.

methods.name: int eqInt(self, input: int)
methods.description: Returns the integer input, testing integer scripting.

methods.name: float eqFloat(self, input: float)
methods.description: Returns the float input, testing float scripting.

methods.name: str eqStr(self, input: str)
methods.description: Returns the string input, testing string scripting.

methods.name: Tensor eqTensor(self, input: Tensor)
methods.description: Returns the input tensor, testing tensor scripting.

methods.name: dict[str,int] eqDictStrKeyIntValue(self, input: dict[str, int])
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with string keys and integer values, testing dict scripting.

methods.name: dict[int,int] eqDictIntKeyIntValue(self, input: dict[int, int])
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with integer keys and integer values.

methods.name: dict[float,int] eqDictFloatKeyIntValue(self, input: dict[float, int])
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with float keys and integer values.

methods.name: tuple[list[int],int] listIntSumReturnTuple(self, input: list[int])
methods.description: Returns the list and sum of its elements, testing list processing.

methods.name: bool listBoolConjunction(self, input: list[bool])
methods.description: Returns conjunction of boolean list, testing list logical operations.

methods.name: bool listBoolDisjunction(self, input: list[bool])
methods.description: Returns disjunction of boolean list.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[int,int,int],int] tupleIntSumReturnTuple( self, input: tuple[int, int, int] )
methods.description: Returns the tuple and sum of its elements.

methods.name: bool optionalIntIsNone(self, input: Optional[int])
methods.description: Checks if optional integer is None.

methods.name: Optional[int] intEq0None(self, input: int)
methods.description: Returns None if input is zero; else returns input.

methods.name: str str3Concat(self, input: str)
methods.description: Concatenates the string three times.

methods.name: newEmptyShapeWithItem(self, input)
methods.description: Creates a tensor from item's integer value.

methods.name: list[Tensor] testAliasWithOffset(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of tensor elements, testing aliasing.

methods.name: testNonContiguous(self)
methods.description: Returns a non-contiguous tensor slice.

methods.name: Tensor conv2d(self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool)
methods.description: Performs 2D convolution with optional channels-last format.

methods.name: Tensor conv3d(self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool)
methods.description: Performs 3D convolution with optional channels-last format.

methods.name: Tensor contiguous(self, x: Tensor)
methods.description: Returns contiguous copy of tensor.

methods.name: Tensor contiguousChannelsLast(self, x: Tensor)
methods.description: Returns tensor with channels-last memory format.

methods.name: Tensor contiguousChannelsLast3d(self, x: Tensor)
methods.description: Returns tensor with channels-last 3D memory format.

ctags.name: conv2d
ctags.pattern: /^    def conv2d(self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool) -> Tensor:$/
ctags.signature: (self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool)

ctags.name: conv3d
ctags.pattern: /^    def conv3d(self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool) -> Tensor:$/
ctags.signature: (self, x: Tensor, w: Tensor, toChannelsLast: bool)

ctags.pattern: /^    def eqDictFloatKeyIntValue(self, input: dict[float, int]) -> dict[float, int]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def eqDictStrKeyIntValue(self, input: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, int]:$/
